purpose: Bring Mara into Red Hollow and establish the storm damage and Eli.
entry: Mara walks from the morning freight stop toward the station office.
exit: Eli tells Mara the relay in the signal shed is still dead.

may_reveal: The west span was damaged by the storm.

purpose: Have Mara diagnose the dead relay while creating pressure around Eli's concealed knowledge without revealing the satchel.
entry: Mara and Eli enter the signal shed to inspect the relay.
required_movements: Mara verifies that the relay itself is intact.
Evidence points toward a break or ground fault outside the shed.
Mara notices that one floorboard has cleaner edges than the surrounding boards but has no reason to identify why.
Eli redirects attention to the west span without making a factual claim that contradicts Canon.
exit: Mara decides to walk the west span and inspect the line physically.

may_reveal: The relay is not the primary fault.
A floorboard appears to have been disturbed recently.
must_conceal: The existence of the dispatch satchel.
Eli's reason for wanting the floor ignored.

purpose: After the line is restored, have Mara send the first message and notice a discrepancy in the station traffic log.
entry: Mara returns to the office after repairing the west span.
exit: She records the discrepancy for follow-up rather than confronting Eli immediately.
